blurb: Open ground. One move to cross and nothing to hide behind — every hit lands clean, for you and against you.
Cover at a price. Two move to enter, but anything standing in it is twenty percent harder to kill.
The wall. Three move to climb and forty percent defense at the top. Land units grind across it — slow ground you pay to hold.
A moat. Land units cannot cross it; only sea and air move through. Use it to anchor a flank.
Held ground. Light cover, and the one tile infantry can take for a small stream of Fame.
The only hex armor crosses Water on. One move, and ten percent off your defense while you stand on it. Contest it, do not park on it.
Builds units and repairs them. Fifteen percent cover, and infantry can take it — hold one and it pays a hundred Fame a turn.
